085        public static class KantaFavorTrigger implements EveryFrameScript {
086
087                public static float MIN_ELAPSED = 720f;
088                
089                // around 50ish percent after 5 cycles
090                // want this to feel unpredictable and like it might not happen
091                public static float PROB_PER_MONTH = 0.01f;
092                
093                public static float MIN_DELAY_BETWEEN_COURIERS = 60f;
094                public static float MAX_DELAY_BETWEEN_COURIERS = 90f;
095                public static int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
096                
097                
098                protected IntervalUtil interval = new IntervalUtil(20f, 40f);
099                protected float elapsed = 0f;
100                protected float resendTimeout = 0f;
101                protected int attempts = 0;
102                protected Random random = new Random();
103                protected boolean done = false;
104
105                public void advance(float amount) {
106                        if (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$affk_inProgress")) {
107                                done = true;
108                                return;
109                        }
110                        
111                        //amount *= 1000f;
112                        
113                        float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
114                        elapsed += days;
115                        
116                        boolean send = false;
117                        
118                        interval.advance(days);
119                        if (interval.intervalElapsed()) {
120                                if (random.nextFloat() < PROB_PER_MONTH) {
121                                        send = true;
122                                }
123                        }
124                        
125//                      if (true) {
126//                              loseProtection(null);
127//                              Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage("Kanta's Protection lost", Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor());
128//                              send = false;
129//                              done = true;
130//                              return;
131//                      }
132                        
133                        if (attempts <= 0 && elapsed < MIN_ELAPSED) {
134                                send = false; // initial timeout
135                        }
136                        if (attempts > 0 && elapsed < resendTimeout) {
137                                send = false; // sent a courier recently
138                        } else if (attempts > 0) {
139                                if (attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) { // too many failed attempts
140                                        loseProtection(null);
141                                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage("Kanta's Protection lost", Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor());
142                                        send = false;
143                                        done = true;
144                                        return;
145                                } else {
146                                        send = true; // sent a courier already, and not recently - always send another one
147                                }
148                        }
149                        
150                        //send = true;
151                        if (send) {
152                                elapsed = 0;
153                                sendCourier();
154                                attempts++;
155                                resendTimeout = MIN_DELAY_BETWEEN_COURIERS + 
156                                                           (MAX_DELAY_BETWEEN_COURIERS - MIN_DELAY_BETWEEN_COURIERS) * random.nextFloat();
157                        }
158                }
159                
160                public boolean isDone() {
161                        return done;
162                }
163
164                public boolean runWhilePaused() {
165                        return false;
166                }
167                
168                public void sendCourier() {
169                        DelayedFleetEncounter e = new DelayedFleetEncounter(random, "kantaFavorCourier");
170                        e.setDelayNone();
171                        e.setLocationInnerSector(false, null);
172                        e.setEncounterFromSomewhereInSystem();
173                        e.setDoNotAbortWhenPlayerFleetTooStrong();
174                        e.beginCreate();
175                        e.triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.VERY_SMALL, FleetQuality.HIGHER, 
176                                                                Factions.PIRATES, FleetTypes.PATROL_SMALL, new Vector2f());
177                        e.triggerFleetSetName("Courier");
178                        e.triggerMakeNonHostile();
179                        e.triggerFleetMakeImportantPermanent(null);
180                        e.triggerFleetMakeFaster(true, 0, true);
181                        e.triggerOrderFleetInterceptPlayer();
182                        e.triggerMakeFleetIgnoredByOtherFleets();
183                        e.triggerMakeFleetIgnoreOtherFleetsExceptPlayer();
184                        e.triggerOrderFleetEBurn(1f);
185                        e.triggerSetFleetGenericHailPermanent("KantaFavorCourierHail");
186                        e.endCreate();
187                }
188                
189        }

192        public static class TakingBackTheNanoforgeChecker implements ColonyPlayerHostileActListener {
193                protected MarketAPI market;
194                public TakingBackTheNanoforgeChecker(MarketAPI market) {
195                        this.market = market;
196                }
197
198                public void reportRaidForValuablesFinishedBeforeCargoShown(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, MarketAPI market,
199                                TempData actionData, CargoAPI cargo) {
200                        if (this.market.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED)) {
201                                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().removeListener(this);
202                        }
203                        if (actionData.secret) {
204                                return;
205                        }
206                        if (market == this.market) {
207                                if (cargo.getQuantity(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, new SpecialItemData(Items.PRISTINE_NANOFORGE, null)) > 0) {
208                                        PersonAPI kanta = People.getPerson(People.KANTA);
209                                        if (kanta != null) {
210                                                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
211                                                text.addPara("Word of this is bound to get back to Kanta. "
212                                                                + "You can't imagine she would react well to being made a fool of.");
213                                                loseProtection(dialog);
214                                        }
215                                        Global.getSector().getListenerManager().removeListener(this);
216                                }
217                        }
218                }

221                }

224                }

227                }

231        public static class FusionLampColorChanger implements EveryFrameScript {
232                public boolean isDone() {
233                        return market.getContainingLocation() == null;
234                }
235
236                public boolean runWhilePaused() {
237                        return false;
238                }
239                
240                protected MarketAPI market;
241                protected IntervalUtil interval = new IntervalUtil(0.5f, 1f);
242                public FusionLampColorChanger(MarketAPI market) {
243                        this.market = market;
244                }
245
246                public void advance(float amount) {
247                        float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
248                        if (Global.getSector().getClock().getMonth() == 11 &&
249                                        Global.getSector().getClock().getDay() == 28) {
250                                days *= 100f;
251                        }
252                                
253                        interval.advance(days);
254                        if (interval.intervalElapsed()) {
255                                for (CustomCampaignEntityAPI curr : market.getContainingLocation().getCustomEntities()) {
256                                        if (curr.getCustomEntityType().equals(Entities.FUSION_LAMP) &&
257                                                        curr.getOrbitFocus() == market.getPrimaryEntity()) {
258                                                
259                                                WeightedRandomPicker<Pair<Color, Color>> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<Pair<Color, Color>>();
260                                                
261                                                // orange
262                                                picker.add(new Pair<Color, Color>(FusionLampEntityPlugin.GLOW_COLOR, FusionLampEntityPlugin.LIGHT_COLOR));
263                                                
264                                                // red
265                                                picker.add(new Pair<Color, Color>(new Color(255,50,50,255), new Color(255,50,50,255)));
266                                                
267                                                // blue
268                                                picker.add(new Pair<Color, Color>(new Color(210,230,255,255), new Color(210,230,255,255)));
269                                                
270                                                // white
271                                                picker.add(new Pair<Color, Color>(new Color(245,250,255,255), new Color(245,250,255,255)));
272                                                
273                                                // yellow
274                                                picker.add(new Pair<Color, Color>(new Color(255,225,125,255), new Color(255,225,125,255)));
275                                                
276                                                // green
277                                                picker.add(new Pair<Color, Color>(new Color(100,255,100,255), new Color(100,255,100,255)));
278                                                
279                                                Pair<Color, Color> pick = picker.pick();
280                                                
281                                                FusionLampEntityPlugin plugin = (FusionLampEntityPlugin) curr.getCustomPlugin();
282                                                plugin.setGlowColor(pick.one);
283                                                plugin.setLightColor(pick.two);
284                                                
285                                                break;
286                                        }
287                                }
288                                
289                        }
290                }
291        }

293        public static class DelayedInstallItemScript extends DelayedActionScript {
294                protected MarketAPI market;
295                protected String industryId;
296                protected String itemId;
297
298                public DelayedInstallItemScript(float daysLeft, MarketAPI market, String industryId, String itemId) {
299                        super(daysLeft);
300                        this.market = market;
301                        this.industryId = industryId;
302                        this.itemId = itemId;
303                }
304
305                @Override
306                public void doAction() {
307                        InstallableItemEffect effect = ItemEffectsRepo.ITEM_EFFECTS.get(itemId);
308                        Industry ind = market.getIndustry(industryId);
309                        if (ind != null && effect != null && !market.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED)) {
310                                List<String> unmet = effect.getUnmetRequirements(ind);
311                                if (unmet == null || unmet.isEmpty()) {
312                                        ind.setSpecialItem(new SpecialItemData(itemId, null));
313                                }
314                        }
315                }
316        }

318        
319        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
320                if (dialog == null) return false;
321                
322                OptionPanelAPI options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
323                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
324                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
325                CargoAPI cargo = pf.getCargo();
326                
327                String action = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
328                
329                MemoryAPI memory = memoryMap.get(MemKeys.LOCAL);
330                if (memory == null) return false; // should not be possible unless there are other big problems already
331                
332                MarketAPI market = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMarket();
333                
334                if ("findLargeOmega".equals(action)) {
335                        for (CargoStackAPI stack : cargo.getStacksCopy()) {
336                                if (!stack.isWeaponStack()) continue;
337                                
338                                WeaponSpecAPI spec = stack.getWeaponSpecIfWeapon();
339                                if (spec.getSize() != WeaponSize.LARGE) continue;
340                                
341                                if (!spec.hasTag(Tags.OMEGA)) continue;
342                                
343                                memory.set("$foundWeaponId", spec.getWeaponId());                               
344                                memory.set("$foundWeaponName", spec.getWeaponName());                           
345                                memory.set("$foundWeaponQuantity", (int) Math.round(stack.getSize()));
346                                return true;
347                        }
348                } else if ("findContactToBetray".equals(action)) {
349                        ContactIntel best = null;
350                        int bestImportance = 0;
351                        float bestRel = 0f;
352                        for (IntelInfoPlugin curr : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(ContactIntel.class)) {
353                                ContactIntel intel = (ContactIntel) curr;
354                                if (intel.isEnding() || intel.isEnded() || intel.getState() == ContactState.POTENTIAL) continue;
355                                
356                                int importance = intel.getPerson().getImportance().ordinal();
357                                float rel = intel.getPerson().getRelToPlayer().getRel();
358                                
359                                if (intel.getPerson().getImportance().ordinal() <= PersonImportance.MEDIUM.ordinal()) continue;
360                                //if (intel.getPerson().getRelToPlayer().isAtBest(RepLevel.WELCOMING)) continue;
361                                
362                                if (importance > bestImportance || (importance >= bestImportance && rel > bestRel)) {
363                                        best = intel;
364                                        bestImportance = importance;
365                                        bestRel = rel;
366                                }
367                        }
368                                
369                        if (best == null) return false;
370                        
371                        PersonAPI contact = best.getPerson();
372                        memory.set("$foundContactName", contact.getNameString());                               
373                        memory.set("$foundContactRank", contact.getRank().toLowerCase());                               
374                        memory.set("$foundContactPost", contact.getPost().toLowerCase());
375                        memory.set("$foundContactFaction", contact.getFaction().getPersonNamePrefixAOrAn() + " " + contact.getFaction().getPersonNamePrefix());                         
376                        memory.set("$foundContactIntel", best);                         
377                        
378                        return true;
379                } else if ("betrayContact".equals(action)) {
380                        ContactIntel intel = (ContactIntel) memory.get("$foundContactIntel");
381                        CustomRepImpact impact = new CustomRepImpact();
382                        impact.delta = -0.75f;
383                        Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
384                                        new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.CUSTOM, 
385                                                        impact, null, text, true, true),
386                                                        intel.getPerson());
387                        intel.loseContact(dialog);
388                } else if ("gaveHamatsu".equals(action)) {
389                        PersonAPI ibrahim = People.getPerson(People.IBRAHIM);
390                        if (ibrahim != null) {
391                                CustomRepImpact impact = new CustomRepImpact();
392                                impact.delta = -2f;
393                                Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
394                                                new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.CUSTOM, 
395                                                                impact, null, text, true, true),
396                                                                ibrahim);
397                                ContactIntel intel = ContactIntel.getContactIntel(ibrahim);
398                                if (intel !=  null) {
399                                        intel.loseContact(dialog);
400                                }
401                        }
402                } else if ("findRemnantCapital".equals(action)) {
403                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : pf.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
404                                if (member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.SHIP_REMNANTS) && member.isCapital()) {
405                                        memory.set("$foundShipId", member.getId());                             
406                                        memory.set("$foundShipClass", member.getHullSpec().getNameWithDesignationWithDashClass());                              
407                                        memory.set("$foundShipName", member.getShipName());                             
408                                        return true;
409                                }
410                        }
411                } else if ("findShieldBlueprint".equals(action)) {
412                        for (CargoStackAPI stack : cargo.getStacksCopy()) {
413                                if (!stack.isSpecialStack()) continue;
414                                
415                                SpecialItemData data = stack.getSpecialDataIfSpecial();
416                                if (data.getData() == null) continue;
417                                
418                                if (!data.getId().equals(Items.INDUSTRY_BP)) continue;
419                                
420                                IndustrySpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getIndustrySpec(data.getData());
421                                
422                                if (spec.getId().equals(Industries.PLANETARYSHIELD)) {
423                                        memory.set("$foundIndustryId", spec.getId());
424                                        String firstWord = stack.getDisplayName().split(" ")[0];
425                                        memory.set("$foundIndustryName", Misc.ucFirst(Misc.getAOrAnFor(firstWord)) + " " + stack.getDisplayName().replace("Blueprint", "blueprint"));                           
426                                        return true;
427                                }
428                        }
429                } else if ("findShipBlueprint".equals(action)) {
430                        FactionAPI pirates = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
431                        for (CargoStackAPI stack : cargo.getStacksCopy()) {
432                                if (!stack.isSpecialStack()) continue;
433                                
434                                SpecialItemData data = stack.getSpecialDataIfSpecial();
435                                if (data.getData() == null) continue;
436                                
437                                if (!data.getId().equals(Items.SHIP_BP)) continue;
438                                
439                                if (pirates.knowsShip(data.getData())) continue;
440                                
441                                ShipHullSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getHullSpec(data.getData());
442                                
443                                boolean match = spec.hasTag(Tags.KANTA_GIFT);
444                                match |= !spec.isCivilianNonCarrier() && spec.getHullSize() == HullSize.CAPITAL_SHIP;
445                                
446                                if (match) {
447                                        memory.set("$foundShipBPId", data.getData());
448                                        String firstWord = stack.getDisplayName().split(" ")[0];
449                                        memory.set("$foundShipBPName", Misc.ucFirst(Misc.getAOrAnFor(firstWord)) + " " + stack.getDisplayName().replace("Blueprint", "blueprint"));                             
450                                        return true;
451                                }
452                        }
453                } else if ("learnShipBP".equals(action)) {
454                        String hullId = params.get(1).getString(memoryMap);
455                        float daysDelay = params.get(2).getFloat(memoryMap);
456                        DelayedBlueprintLearnScript script = new DelayedBlueprintLearnScript(Factions.PIRATES, daysDelay);
457                        script.getShips().add(hullId);
458                        Global.getSector().addScript(script);
459                        return true;
460                } else if ("oweKantaAFavor".equals(action)) {
461                        Global.getSector().addScript(new KantaFavorTrigger());
462                } else if ("abortFavor".equals(action)) {
463                        Global.getSector().removeScriptsOfClass(KantaFavorTrigger.class);
464                } else if ("alreadyDidFavor".equals(action)) {
465                        return !Global.getSector().hasScript(KantaFavorTrigger.class) && playerHasProtection();
466                                        //!Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$affk_inProgress");
467                } else if ("installFusionLamp".equals(action)) {
468                        SpecialItemData data = new SpecialItemData(Items.ORBITAL_FUSION_LAMP, null);
469                        InstallableItemEffect effect = ItemEffectsRepo.ITEM_EFFECTS.get(data.getId());
470                        Industry ind = market.getIndustry(Industries.POPULATION);
471                        if (ind != null && effect != null) {
472                                List<String> unmet = effect.getUnmetRequirements(ind);
473                                if (unmet == null || unmet.isEmpty()) {
474                                        ind.setSpecialItem(data);
475                                        market.getPrimaryEntity().addScript(new FusionLampColorChanger(market));
476                                }
477                        }
478                        return true;
479                } else if ("buildPlanetaryShield".equals(action)) {
480                        Industry ind = market.getIndustry(Industries.PLANETARYSHIELD);
481                        if (ind == null) {
482                                market.addIndustry(Industries.PLANETARYSHIELD);
483                                
484                                // not very promising - shield is under the station etc
485//                              PlanetAPI planet = market.getContainingLocation().addPlanet(market.getId() + "_fakeForShield", market.getPrimaryEntity(), "", Planets.TUNDRA, 0, 100f, 0f, 1f);
486//                              market.getConnectedEntities().add(planet);
487//                              ind = market.getIndustry(Industries.PLANETARYSHIELD);
488//                              if (ind != null) {
489//                                      ind.startBuilding();
490//                              }
491                        }
492                        return true;
493                } else if ("gavePristineNanoforge".equals(action)) {
494                        float daysDelay = params.get(1).getFloat(memoryMap);
495                        //daysDelay = 0;
496                        MarketAPI kapteyn = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("station_kapteyn");
497                        if (kapteyn != null) {
498                                Global.getSector().addScript(
499                                                new DelayedInstallItemScript(daysDelay, 
500                                                                kapteyn, Industries.ORBITALWORKS, Items.PRISTINE_NANOFORGE));
501                                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().addListener(new TakingBackTheNanoforgeChecker(kapteyn));
502                        }
503                        return true;
504                } else if ("kapteynHasForge".equals(action)) {
505                        MarketAPI kapteyn = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("station_kapteyn");
506                        if (kapteyn == null || kapteyn.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED)) return false;
507                        
508                        Industry ind = market.getIndustry(Industries.ORBITALWORKS);
509                        if (ind == null) return false;
510                        
511                        return ind.getSpecialItem() != null && Items.PRISTINE_NANOFORGE.equals(ind.getSpecialItem().getId()); 
512                } else if ("gainProtection".equals(action)) {
513                        Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(KANTA_PROTECTION, true);
514                        Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(EVER_HAD_KANTA_PROTECTION, true);
515                        text.setFontSmallInsignia();
516                        text.addPara("Kanta's Protection gained", Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor());
517                        text.setFontInsignia();
518                        
519                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playUISound("ui_rep_raise", 1f, 1f);
520                        
521                        PirateHostileActivityFactor.avertOrAbortRaid();
522                        
523                        HostileActivityEventIntel intel = HostileActivityEventIntel.get();
524                        if (intel != null) {
525                                intel.addFactor(new KantasProtectionOneTimeFactor(-Global.getSettings().getInt("HA_kantaProtection")), dialog);
526                        }
527                        
528                        new PiracyRespiteScript();
529                        
530                } else if ("loseProtection".equals(action)) {
531                        loseProtection(dialog);
532                }
533                
534                
535                
536                return false;
537        }
538
539        public static void loseProtection(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
540                if (!playerHasProtection()) return;
541                
542                PersonAPI kanta = People.getPerson(People.KANTA);
543                if (kanta != null) {
544                        Misc.incrUntrustwortyCount();
545                        
546                        TextPanelAPI text = dialog == null ? null : dialog.getTextPanel();
547                        CustomRepImpact impact = new CustomRepImpact();
548                        impact.delta = -0.5f;
549                        Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
550                                        new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.CUSTOM, 
551                                                        impact, null, text, true, true),
552                                                        kanta);
553                        Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(KANTA_PROTECTION);
554                        if (text != null) {
555                                text.setFontSmallInsignia();
556                                text.addPara("Kanta's Protection lost", Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor());
557                                text.setFontInsignia();
558                        }
559                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playUISound("ui_rep_drop", 1f, 1f);
560                }
561        }
